name: EZTest
description: Run EZTest journeys, publish results and evidence to Azure Test Plans and the pipeline, report to the pull request, and enforce the release readiness gate.
helpMarkDown: EZTest for Azure DevOps: see docs/azure-devops.md in the EZTest package.
author: EZTest

inputs.name: command
inputs.label: Command
inputs.helpMarkDown: What the step does. 'all' installs, runs, publishes and gates in one step.

options.auto: npm ci when there is a package-lock.json

inputs.name: setupCommand
inputs.label: Setup command
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run before the journeys (no shell; quote arguments), e.g. browser or app setup.

inputs.name: journeys
inputs.label: Journeys
inputs.helpMarkDown: Journey files or directories (space separated). Default: journeysDir from the config.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.label: Environment
inputs.helpMarkDown: --env: selects config/<env>.yaml, including that environment's test plan and suite ids.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.label: Tags
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only journeys with any of these tags (comma separated).

inputs.name: shard
inputs.label: Shard
inputs.helpMarkDown: 'auto' uses the job's position in a parallel strategy (System.JobPositionInPhase / System.TotalJobsInPhase); 'none', or i/n.

inputs.name: runDirectory
inputs.label: Run directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: For 'publish' and 'gate': the run to use. Default: the newest run in the results directory.

inputs.name: publishTestResults
inputs.label: Publish to the pipeline Tests tab (JUnit)

inputs.name: publishArtifact
inputs.label: Publish the run (report, evidence) as a pipeline artifact

inputs.name: signingKey
inputs.label: Signing key file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the ed25519 private key PEM (e.g. from a secure file: $(signingKey.secureFilePath)).

inputs.name: publishTestPlans
inputs.label: Publish to Azure Test Plans
inputs.helpMarkDown: Results with step results, iterations and attachments, linked to this build.

inputs.name: prReport
inputs.label: Post status and summary to the pull request
inputs.helpMarkDown: In pull request builds: the 'EZTest' status (GO / NO_GO) and one summary comment, updated on re-runs.

inputs.name: failOnTestFailure
inputs.label: Without a readiness policy, fail when journeys fail

inputs.name: eztestCommand
inputs.label: EZTest command
inputs.helpMarkDown: How to start the CLI (default: npx --no-install eztest).

outputVariables.name: EztestDecision
outputVariables.description: GO, GO_WITH_RISKS or NO_GO (empty without a readiness policy).
